gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

This PR adds an on-demand CSV export, and the branch was rebased onto main with one conflict in src/export.ts resolved and no commits dropped. The spec covers the CSV download and its header format, defers scheduled exports to acme/widgets#46, deliberately buffers the whole file instead of streaming it, and leaves the export screen to acme/export-ui; you are the author, and robin and the acme/reviewers team are also requested.

Two problems block merging.

1. The exporter writes the rows without the header line, so a downloaded file has no column names. The local test run failed on export_header in tests/export.test.mjs (src/export.ts:31).
2. The guide says exports run nightly, but the button exports on demand, so a reader waits for a file that never arrives (docs/export.md:8). A correction to the guide is drafted.

maria's comment about the missing header (comment-73) is correct; the drafted reply agrees and says the fix is coming. The build passed in CI, but the required unit check is still running, so merging also waits on it. Two of the three items from your earlier review are now addressed. One smaller point does not block merging: the export loop repeats the shared paging helper's code (src/export.ts:44), and deliver with nits can take it.

I recommend deliver because both problems have repairs ready and this is your PR.

Pick one:
1. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. deliver with nits - the same, and also replace the repeated paging code with the shared helper.
3. assess - post the two problems to the PR as one review and make no repairs.
4. stop - end the run without repairs and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
